programme.desc: Beep. Educational fun. The Alphablocks meet a metal box that goes beep, and soon it's walking and talking and wishing it could be like its new friends.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Stop. Wonderblock Stop is Go's new best friend! She loves to think things through. Stop shows her new friends how taking a moment to reflect can help solve all sorts of problems.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Many Mixes Make Brown. Brown takes the Colourblocks exploring in the forest. Learn different ways to mix brown with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Building Block Badge. The Squirrels become architects so they can design, build and bring to life their very own clubhouse.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: March of the Ants. Twinkle and Yukee try to stop marching ants from taking seeds from the vegetable garden.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Dragon School. Justin visits a friend's school to make a recycled dragon and to take part in a dragon parade. Meanwhile, it's school photo day with Teacher Tumble - say cheese!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Making Sounds. Preschool fun from Teletubbyland. Po makes silly, funny sounds with the levers and buttons in Home Dome and then the Tubby Phone rings for a silly Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures
programme.desc: Andy and the Arctic Fox. Preschool wildlife series. Jen accidentally destroys a video of an Arctic fox, so Andy takes his safari-mobile to the Arctic to record new footage.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle and the Swimming Pool. Preschool comedy drama series. Waffle has so much fun on a doggy playdate at Mr Willow's house that he decides to stay for a sleepover.

programme.title: Topsy and Tim
programme.desc: Two Dogs. Live-action children's show. Topsy is feeling better, but she's bored of resting. That is, until DIY Derek visits with his new little dog, Teddy!

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Hide and Toot. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. The animals are playing hide-and-seek, but Huffty's trunk keeps giving him away.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: An Applephant for Boxy. The Game Catchers land on a planet with rivers and lakes made of fruit juice, and learn to play hoop game.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Manatees. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. Running out of air, Barnacles struggles to free his paw from the mouth of a giant clam.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Great Breakout. Animated series. When Mr McGregor captures the whole squirrel tribe in his garden, Peter must stage a mass breakout to save his friends.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Juice Badge. Animated preschool series. Duggee makes the Squirrels juice from fresh fruit in the garden. The Squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Fergie's Horrible Hiccups. When Fergie gets hiccups before her concert, Vida needs to come up with a preshow cure!

programme.title: New: Supertato
programme.desc: Melon Melon. Evil Pea befriends the playful but destructive Baby Watermelon to destroy Tato Tower. Her plan backfires when Baby Watermelon gets cranky.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: The Shiny Fruit. Cosima and Big Lizard find some fascinatingly slippery fruit, but bringing it safely back to the ship is more challenging than they imagined!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: The Swoppiton Duck. A big duck statue needs pulling up treacherous Swoppiton Hill. Will Mojo and Bo make it?

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bin Night. Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her. Mum offers some good advice.

programme.desc: The Piris' Inky Issue. The Piri friends damage a picture in Millie's cave and must fix it before she finds out.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle and the Good Dog. Preschool comedy drama series. Jess hopes the Essam family's well-behaved dog, Baxter, will teach Waffle how to be good, but Waffle has other ideas...
